description.value: Mr Mikes is a Canadian casual steakhouse chain with roots going back to 1960, offering premium steaks, burgers, pastas, salads, and shareable appetizers in a relaxed, come-as-you-are atmosphere. The Kamloops location on Summit Drive serves dine-in, takeout, and delivery, making it a solid option for a sit-down meal or a meal to go after a long day on the road. The brand prides itself on being unstuffy and welcoming to locals and tourists alike.
